evidence.text:
MIGRATION AND CREDIT TRANSFERS
1.
Migration of a student will only be allowed from the HEC recognized institutions/ universities, subject to the approval of the DHA
Suffa University. No migration will be allowed in one-year programs. Students desiring to migrate to the University are required to
produce an NOC from their previous institute/university.
2.
Transfer of Credits for courses taken at other institutions will be considered on the basis of course contents, Credit Hours and basic
eligibility criteria. The Equivalence Committee will make a recommendation on the case to Dean of the Faculty. Credits will be
transferred subject to following conditions:
a)
a maximum of 50% of the total credits in the program to which transfer is sought can be transferred;
b)
only those courses will be transferred where the original earned grade is ‘C’ or better for undergraduate programs and ‘B’ or better
for graduate programs;
c)
transferred courses are not to be used in calculating student’s CGPA at DSU; and
d)
students with transferred courses will not be eligible for award of medals except where exempted as per rules.
3.
The migration and transfer of credits policy shall not violate the regulations of HEC/PEC or any other accreditation body.
4.
Cases for Migration will require approval of the Vice Chancellor and Transfer of Credits will require the approval of the Dean of the
Faculty. In both cases, the Registrar will issue notification of approval.

Only transfers from HEC-recognized institutions are considered, with prior NOC. A maximum of 50% of total program credits can transfer. Minimum original grade is C for undergraduate and B for graduate courses; transferred courses are excluded from DSU CGPA. Conditions and approvals are detailed on the source page.

**Source:** https://www.dsu.edu.pk/admission-regulations/
**Provenance:** `admission_regulations` (source PDF; capture date unknown).

Question: What is the credit transfer policy from other universities?
Answer: The University will entertain students who want to transfer to DSU from other HEC recognized universities. This will only be
possible if their cases are compliant with the University’s laid down rules for transfer of credits.

Is there any application processing fee?
Candidates pay Rs. 1000/- as the basic application processing fee with their Admission Forms.
What is the criterion for Diploma Students?
Candidates holding a 3-year Diploma from DAE (equivalent to Intermediate) are eligible for admission if their scores are equivalent
or above 60%. Candidates must bring their IBCC Equivalence Certificate of DAE.
Diploma holders of 1 and 2 years are not eligible for admission.
What is the credit transfer policy from other universities?
The University will entertain students who want to transfer to DSU from other HEC recognized universities. This will only be
possible if their cases are compliant with the University’s laid down rules for transfer of credits.
What is the last date for the submission of form?
As notified by the Admissions Office.
What is the procedure for taking admission in DSU for international students?
The foreign applicants have to go through the process as per HEC (Higher Education Commission Pakistan) rules and regulations.
The Fee Structure for foreign students is different.
How do I apply for financial aid?
Students have to submit the complete fee at the time of admission, but for the subsequent semesters, the following
scholarships/interest-free loan facilities are available for students:
1. Merit-based Scholarship
2. Need-based Scholarship
3. Interest-free Loan from Ihsan Trust
4. Facility to pay Semester Fee in 2-3 installments

- “Can I transfer credits?” → Admission Regulations, not generic FAQs alone.
- “What is the processing fee?” → Spring 2027 notice if that session is specified; otherwise surface discrepancy and request confirmation.
- “Is there hostel accommodation?” → DCK hostel facilities; do not promise a vacancy.
